mentions.name: LogBuddy
mentions.description: Health tracking app that combines nutrition, workout, weight, and period tracking in one place with a dead simple interface. Currently available as an Android APK, with a Play Store release and iOS version planned if there is interest.
mentions.problem: The author was tired of juggling separate apps for nutrition, workouts, weight, and period tracking, and wanted all their health data in one place.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been building a health tracking app called LogBuddy. I got tired of using separate apps for nutrition, workouts, weight, and period tracking. So I built LogBuddy to handle all of it with a dead simple interface.

evidence.value: I've been building a health tracking app called LogBuddy. I got tired of using separate apps for nutrition, workouts, weight, and period tracking. So I built LogBuddy to handle all of it with a dead simple interface.
